rca_of_issue: Reproduction for mobile chat sheet bug: open active match on 390x844 -> tap Team chat -> attempt tap on voice tab or send button. Playwright reports element outside viewport despite sheet visible. Likely root cause is bottom sheet/container height + keyboard/safe-area interaction causing controls to sit beyond tappable viewport.
